message.content:
**Pantone “Sky Blue” – Common References**

| Shade | Approximate Pantone Code |
|-------|--------------------------|
| Light Sky Blue | **PANTONE 290 C** |
| Bright/True Sky Blue | **PANTONE 292 C** |

> *Note:*  
> - Pantone’s catalog contains dozens of “blue‑ish” hues that designers sometimes label as “sky blue.”  
> - If you’re working from a physical Pantone swatch book, look under the light‑to‑medium blues section—both PANTONE 290 C and 292 C fall into this range.  
> - For digital work, use the closest hex values:
>   - PANTONE 290 C ≈ #D0E7FF  
>   - PANTONE 292 C ≈ #8ED2F9  

If your project requires a precise match, it’s best to pull out the actual Pantone swatches or consult the latest Pantone Color Guide, because slight differences exist between print and screen displays.
